title: Ja'afar the Barmecide and the Old Badawi
logline: On a desert ride the caliph orders his vizier Jaafar to tease a half-blind old Bedouin; Jaafar prescribes an absurd cure of wind and light, and the old man pays him back with a loud fart, a curse and a quicker wit, winning three thousand dirhams from the laughing caliph.
moral: Mock a poor man and you may find his tongue is sharper than yours: the joke ends in favour of the one it was aimed at.
tone: Broad court comedy with a slow fuse: polite mock gravity, a patient victim, one rude explosion, then warmth. The humour is in faces and timing; the old man keeps his dignity and wins.

beats.summary: The caliph rides into the desert with Jaafar, Abu Nuwas and a companion.
They find an old Bedouin leaning on his donkey and stop.
He is going to Baghdad for eye medicine; he can hardly see (double-vision POV).
The caliph orders Jaafar to tease him.
Jaafar foresees a harsh answer (thought cloud) but the caliph insists.
Asked for a fee, the poor man offers a sincere prayer.
The mock prescription: wind, sunlight, moonlight, lamplight, three months in the air.
A bottomless mortar and a cracked dish: nine months of nothing.
The Bedouin understands he is being mocked; anger becomes a sly idea.
Stretched on his donkey he breaks wind loudly: payment for the prescription.
And if cured, a servant will blacken Jaafar's face after his death (picture balloon).
Fool and curses, until the caliph explodes with laughter.
The caliph rewards the quick wit with three thousand silver dirhams.
The joke ends in the old man's favour; he rides on to Baghdad.

props.description: Planned wordless picture balloon (speech tail). Used small (single icon, about 200 x 150) in S3 and S5 and large in strip mode (660 x 380 in panel space) for the prescription (S6, S7) and the Bedouin's threat (S9).

The flat icons that play inside the balloon: measuring cup (70 x 80), wind (three curl strokes 120 long), small sun (Library sun at r 34), crescent moon (r 34), oilLamp (planned, 90 wide), bowl (140 x 70, tilt shows it empty) and spoon, mortar (planned medicineKit mortar at 2x = 240 x 140, with the new bottomless option), cracked dish (planned platter at 2x, crack 0..1), sparkle mixture (8 four-point stars), eye (ellipse 90 x 50), servant silhouette with pail, blot (7 circles, r 16..30), face icon with turban (r 44), graveMarker (planned), curse bursts (bolt, spiral, star in red jagged bursts 70 wide).
Library thought cloud for Jaafar's foreseen harsh answer (48.64..52.5), 300 x 220 at world (1290, 330), inside scale 0.4.
Planned fat coin purse in its empty state (flat, 50 x 60), turned upside down by the Bedouin at 73.68.

The fart: a cartoon puff cloud (5 scalloped circles, about 130 x 90, pale yellow green #d9e27a with green dot shading and a black brush outline) that bursts out with three speed lines, then drifts along a bezier to Jaafar trailing the planned stinkLines (three wavy strokes, no flies).

Three Library sacks (packLoad 'sack') stacked on the donkey behind the rider, the top one open with planned coinPile coins in a silver palette (white with blue dots) spilling; a counter 1000 / 2000 / 3000 above.

scenes.summary: The second instalment of the fee, told in a picture balloon: when the eye is cured he will send a servant to blacken Jaafar's face after his death.

actions.acting: mock solemn face (brow level, mouth flat) borrowed from Jaafar

scenes.summary: Sitting up on the donkey, the old man calls Jaafar a fool and showers him with curses until the caliph can hold it no longer and explodes with laughter.

camera.notes: Wide cx 1360, cy 615, zoom 1.0 from 142.12. Push to the caliph (cx 1020, cy 560, zoom 2.0) 149.66..150.5; small shake on the laugh; ease back to zoom 1.3, cx 980 at 152.0 to take in Abu Nuwas and the companion.

Curse symbols fly right to left at head height y 600..680. HA HA HA! above the caliph at y 380.

scenes.summary: The caliph admires the quick answer and has three thousand silver dirhams given to the old man, who rides on to Baghdad the winner. THE END.

Sacks stack on the donkey behind the rider; counter above them at world (1760, 470). In the last wide the Bedouin rides left along the road toward the city; THE END title in the sky at panel y 300.

ending.description: Last word ends 165.30. Wide of the road: the Bedouin, astride his donkey with three sacks, rides away left toward Baghdad; Jaafar still guards his nose, the caliph chuckles. THE END (Bangers, style title) pops in the sky at 165.5 with a quiet chime and is held 3.5 s to 169.03 with only breathing, blinks and the receding donkey.

subtitles.ar: خرج الخليفة هارون الرشيد يومًا إلى الصحراء|مع جعفر البرمكي وأبي نواس وأحد أصحابه.|رأوا رجلًا بدويًا مسنًا يستند إلى حماره، فتوقفوا ليسألوه عن رحلته.
subtitles.en: One day Caliph Harun al-Rashid went into the desert|with Jaafar the Barmecide, Abu Nuwas, and a companion.|They saw an old Bedouin leaning against his donkey.

subtitles.ar: قال جعفر للرجل: من أين جئت؟|أجاب: من البصرة. وسأله: إلى أين تذهب؟|قال: إلى بغداد؛ أريد دواءً لعيني،|فقد أصبحت الرؤية صعبة عليّ.
subtitles.en: Jaafar asked where the man had come from.|“Basra,” he said.|He was going to Baghdad to find medicine for his eye,|because he could not see well.

subtitles.ar: أراد هارون أن يضحك، فأمر جعفرًا أن يمزح مع الرجل.|تردد جعفر وقال إن المزاح قد يجلب له جوابًا قاسيًا،|لكن الخليفة أصر، فاقترب جعفر من البدوي.
subtitles.en: Harun wanted some amusement and ordered Jaafar to tease him.|Jaafar hesitated, fearing an unpleasant reply,|but the caliph insisted.

subtitles.ar: قال جعفر: إذا وصفت لك علاجًا يشفي عينك، فماذا تعطيني؟|أجاب العجوز: أسأل الله أن يجزيك خيرًا،|فثوابه خير من كل مال أقدر على دفعه.
subtitles.en: Jaafar asked what reward he would get for a cure.|The old man said he prayed that God would reward him|better than any payment he could offer.

subtitles.ar: قال جعفر بجدية مصطنعة: خذ مقدارًا من أنفاس الريح،|ومثله من ضوء الشمس، ومثله من ضوء القمر والمصباح.|اخلط الأشياء الأربعة جيدًا، ثم اتركها في الهواء ثلاثة أشهر.
subtitles.en: With a solemn face, Jaafar prescribed measures of wind,|sunlight, moonlight, and lamplight,|mixed and left outdoors for three months.

subtitles.ar: واصل جعفر وصفته الغريبة: ضع الخليط في هاون بلا قاع|وادقه ثلاثة أشهر أخرى،|ثم اتركه في طبق مشقوق ثلاثة أشهر.|وبعد ذلك خذ منه كل ليلة، وستشفى عينك!
subtitles.en: Jaafar continued: pound it in a bottomless mortar|for three more months,|leave it in a cracked dish for another three,|then take some each night to cure the eye.

subtitles.ar: فهم البدوي أن جعفرًا يسخر منه.|تمدد فوق حماره وأطلق ريحًا بصوت عال،|ثم قال ساخرًا: خذ هذا أجر وصفتك الآن!|وإذا شفيت عيني، فسأرسل إليك خادمة تسوّد وجهك بالقذر بعد موتك!
subtitles.en: The Bedouin understood the mockery.|He stretched over his donkey, loudly broke wind,|and said, “Take this as payment now!|If I recover, I’ll send a servant who will foul your face after your death!”

subtitles.ar: ثم وصف الرجل جعفرًا بالأحمق وأطلق عليه دعوات قاسية،|حتى انفجر هارون ضاحكًا.|أعجب الخليفة بسرعة بديهة البدوي،|وأمر أن يعطوه ثلاثة آلاف درهم من الفضة، وانتهت المزحة لصالح العجوز.
subtitles.en: He called Jaafar a fool and continued with harsh curses|until Harun burst out laughing.|Delighted by the Bedouin’s quick reply,|the caliph gave him three thousand silver dirhams.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon (26 films). Here: single mode (one icon) and a large strip mode whose content is drawn by a scene callback, with pop in and soap-bubble pop out.
new_assets.implementation: iconBalloon(ctx, x, y, w, h, t, {p, tail: [x, y], inside(c, t)}): rounded white box with a fat black brush outline and a triangular tail (S.box style), scale overshoot on p; clip to the box and call inside(). Draw in panel space after the camera restore so it does not move with pushes; tail end from toPanel(mouth).

new_assets.name: recipeIcons (with medicineKit mortar bottomless option, platter crack, oilLamp, graveMarker)
new_assets.description: Small flat icons for the two balloons, listed with sizes under props. Reuses the planned medicineKit mortar and jar, platterJar platter, oilLamp and graveMarker names; adds only bottomless:true to the mortar (an open ellipse at the base showing the background, contents fall through).
new_assets.implementation: One small function per icon from K shapes (ellipses, rounded rects, 3 to 6 point paths) with the brush outline. Mortar: trapezoid 240 x 140 with a rim ellipse; bottomless draws a second ellipse at the base filled with the balloon paper colour. Crack: 5-segment zigzag stroke revealed by length. Sparkles: K.rng seeded four-point stars falling with fallY. Blot: 7 circles from K.rng(seed).

new_assets.name: gasPuff (with planned stinkLines)
new_assets.description: Comic fart puff: burst, drift, three wavy smell lines; reusable for smoke puffs and bad smells.
new_assets.implementation: Burst phase: Library dustBurst at the hem point recoloured pale yellow green, plus three tapered speed lines for 6 frames. Drift phase: 5 scalloped circles whose centre follows a quadratic bezier from the hem (about 1600, 720) to Jaafar's face (1440, 690) over 3 s, radius growing 20 %, alpha fading from 135 s. stinkLines: three sine strokes rising 60 units above the cloud, phase from t.

new_assets.name: person costume preset 'poet'
new_assets.description: Planned preset for Abu Nuwas: green robe, yellow sash, small tilted white turban with a hanging tail, short pointed black beard, quill in the turban.
new_assets.implementation: Add a COSTUME entry in cast/people.js copying 'merchant' with the palette above, turban scale 0.8 tilted 0.15 rad, a tail strip and a quill line. Fallback without library work: merchant with a green pal.

new_assets.name: reclineOnMount
new_assets.description: A person lying along the back of a donkey (head toward the rump, feet toward the head), then sitting up into the normal rideOn seat. No new drawing: the Library lie pose placed at mountSeat.
new_assets.implementation: const seat = mountSeat('donkey', D); person(ctx, {x: seat.x, y: seat.y, lie: 1, dir: +1 or -1 so the head is toward the rump, ...}) drawn after the donkey; add the donkey's spring y to both. Sit up: lie 1 to 0 over 0.5 s then switch to rideOn on the frame they match (cover with the cut at 142.12).

new_assets.name: soreEye
new_assets.description: The bad eye: the Library wink closes it; three short red ticks under it and a red rim arc mark it as sore; pulse option when he touches it.
new_assets.implementation: Scene overlay drawn after the person at the eye position (head centre + eye offset * s): arc and three 8 unit strokes in C.red, alpha from a pulse.

new_assets.name: doubleVision
new_assets.description: POV of poor sight: the subject layer drawn twice with a slowly changing offset and half alpha, with an eyelid vignette that can close to a slit.
new_assets.implementation: Render the party (no outlines on the second copy if cheap, else same) into the panel twice with ctx.globalAlpha 0.5 and x offsets +-7..14 from Math.sin(t * 3.8); lid = two black-filled arcs closing from top and bottom by a keyed amount. Pure function of t.

new_assets.name: person laugh, flush, templeTap (planned helpers)
new_assets.description: Shared planned helpers reused under their names: the full laugh (mouth open, lid 0.9, tip back, shoulder shake), the anger flush with steam puffs (and soft option), a finger tapped on the temple.
new_assets.implementation: laugh(P, t, t0, amt): sets mouth, lid, tip -0.18 * amt and a 9 Hz sq pulse. flush: red dots clipped to the face circle rising with a keyed level, two small puffs via dustBurst. templeTap: handR target at the temple with two 3 frame taps.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English omits three Arabic clauses (P1 'so they stopped to ask him about his journey', P3 'so Jaafar approached the Bedouin', P8 'and the joke ended in the old man's favour'); both languages are kept verbatim, so those moments show Arabic with the previous English chunk.
The fart is shown as a cartoon puff cloud with the lettering PFFFT! and one quiet raspberry sound; default: shown this way, clearly comic, with no anatomical detail.

The threat to foul Jaafar's face after his death is shown only as icons in the Bedouin's picture balloon (servant silhouette, a black blot on a face icon, a gravestone); default: icons only, nothing done to the real Jaafar.
The curses are shown as wordless symbol bursts bouncing off Jaafar's turban plus the single word FOOL!; default: no written insults beyond FOOL!.
'Stretched over his donkey' is staged as the old man lying back along the donkey like a couch with his feet toward Jaafar; default: this pose (the Library lie pose), not belly down.

Additions beyond the script: the party rides out of a city gate, the caliph and others stay mounted while Jaafar goes on foot, a double-vision POV of the old man's sight, an empty purse, and the ending where the Bedouin rides off to Baghdad and Jaafar flinches at the donkey's lifted tail; default: all kept.

Invented English lettering (18 items): THE CALIPH, JAAFAR, ABU NUWAS, FROM BASRA, TO BAGHDAD, GO!, 3 / 6 / 9 MONTHS, NO BOTTOM, CURED!, PFFFT!, PAYMENT, FOOL!, HEE HAW!, HA HA HA!, 3000, THE END; default: all used.
No LATER card is used because the story is one continuous encounter; default: none.
implementation_notes: World: one desertRoad strip 2400 wide, ground y 900, translate by -camX. Stop positions (feet x): companion 560, Abu Nuwas 790, caliph 1020, Jaafar's horse 1250, Jaafar on foot 1440, donkey 1690 (dir -1), Bedouin 1785. Horses and donkey s 0.8, riders s 0.76 via rideOn, people on foot s 0.95.

Ride in: caliph x = kfn(t, [[0, 380], [15.3, 1020]]) with an eased stop; others at +230, -230, -460. Use walk(xf, t, {stride: GAIT.horse * 0.8}) per horse with different phase offsets and footfalls for dust. All four stop within 15.06..15.6, staggered front to back, each rider with lurch(t, tStop).

Dismounts are never shown: Jaafar is on foot from the cut at 55.26 (hidden by the caliph close-up 52.78..55.2); the companion is on foot from the cut at 158.1. Draw the bay horse riderless after 55.26.

Draw order per frame: set back, far horses and riders (companion, Abu Nuwas), caliph, bay horse, Jaafar, donkey, Bedouin (or lying on / riding the donkey), set front pass, effects (gasPuff, bursts), then in panel space: balloons, labels, counter, finish.

Set LIFE.t = t for automatic blinks; give every character a gaze target each scene (lookAt). The donkey is a listener in every dialogue scene: key its headTurn and ears on the speaker changes listed in the actions.
The Bedouin's bad eye is wink:"R" at all times except when he shuts both (lid 1). Check which side wink "R" closes on a figure facing left and keep the sore eye on the camera side.

Recipe balloon: build the icon timeline as one function recipe(c, t) with pop times from the cue words (79.98, 80.94, 82.50, 85.44, 88.06, 88.64, 89.68, 92.46, 93.92, 95.28, 102.56, 103.10, 104.00, 105.14, 108.82, 109.32, 110.18, 113.10, 114.64, 115.72). The counter is the style counter primitive with the word MONTHS.

Climb at 122.4: anticipate(t, 122.4, 0.3, 0.1), hop arc 122.7..123.2 from (1785, 900) to the mountSeat of the donkey, lie blending 0 to 1; the donkey's y gets a damped spring (14 units, 0.5 s). Verify the lie pose head direction and mirror if needed so the feet point at Jaafar.
The blast is at 128.38, after the narrator finishes "بصوت عال،". Hold everything still from 125.54 (only tremble) so the release reads. Apply the shake inside the panel clip only.
Caliph laugh fuse: he must not laugh openly before 150.62. Stages: grin (39.68), hidden shaking (96.76), cheeks and held breath (132.92, 148.72), three hitches (149.66), explosion (150.62).

Sound: narration is continuous, so only 7 effects: whoosh 9.62, thud 18.7, pops 23.42 and 29.62, raspberry 128.44, chime 161.92, chime 165.7. All SND master 0.6. Measure the real silence at the tail of the word at 127.62..128.48 and put the 0.2 s raspberry inside it; if there is no clean gap, drop the sound and keep the lettering.

Subtitles: use the chunk marks in "subtitles" for chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt; P1, P3 and P8 have Arabic clauses with no English counterpart (see owner_questions), so the last English chunk simply stays up.
Lettering never covers a face: name labels above heads at y 430..470, PFFFT! between the two men above head height, HA HA HA! above the crown.
warnings: The narration has only four real pauses in the first 30 s and none later; effects are therefore few and the raspberry at 128.44 sits on a word boundary and must be checked by ear.
Faces are small in the wides (zoom 1.0: a head is about 55 px); every key expression is given a close or two-shot. Do not let the wides carry acting.
Four mounted riders plus two on-foot actors is the heaviest frame (S2 wide, S10): keep the two rear riders simple (idle, staggered) and check the frame time.
rideOn clips the rider at the saddle and shows the front-facing person; riders cannot turn in profile, so "looking back" is done with gaze and a small head offset only.

The lie pose on the donkey (reclineOnMount) is untested on a mount: check a still at 124.5 and 128.4 before animating the rest; fallback is the Bedouin sitting astride and leaning far back (tip -0.5).
No LATER transition: the story has no passage of time (plancheck will warn).
The poet costume preset is planned, not in the Library yet; the fallback palette is given in cast.
